notes: Drona Parva, fifteenth day, afternoon — the Narayana weapon. No gore: the weapon is golden fire in the sky; no bodies. Drona is narrated only, never drawn. Ashwatthama is a NEW face (first on a plate in the series): young adult Brahmin-warrior, luminous jewel set in his forehead, dark mustache, deep maroon and bronze-gold armor, white sacred thread, lion's-tail banner — never white-bearded, never a child, never saffron sage robes. Krishna = Ep 09 look lock. Arjuna = Ep 09 face lock, cream-white dhoti, no gold chest armor, no peacock (copy Ep 14 lock). Yudhishthira, Bhima = Ep 14 locks. Duryodhana = Ep 13 lock (tall jeweled Kuru crown, saffron-orange cape — distinct from Bhima's circlet and leaf-green armor).

ashwatthama.face: Young adult Brahmin-warrior, son of the guru: noble lean face, dark mustache, intense dark eyes wet with grief and blazing with wrath; a luminous jewel (mani) set in the middle of his forehead — his one unmistakable token; never a child, never white-bearded
ashwatthama.hair: Dark hair tied back under a slim bronze-gold warrior band (no royal crown, no peacock feather, no saffron topknot)
ashwatthama.costume: Deep maroon and bronze-gold engraved armor, white sacred thread across the chest, cream dhoti, great bow; lion's-tail banner on his chariot — no saffron sage robes, no flower garland

krishna.face: Youthful divine smile, dusty-blue skin, dark eyes, serene, U-tilak — same face as Ep 09 lock
krishna.hair: Dark curly hair, gold crown with one peacock feather
krishna.costume: Yellow pitambar, flower garlands, gold jewelry, charioteer reins — never a flute, never a bow

arjuna.face: Noble warrior prince, dark mustache, same face as Ep 09 lock (episodes/09-gita/stills/_locks/arjuna.jpg)
arjuna.costume: Cream-white dhoti and cream angavastram, gold belt, quiver on back, Gandiva — no gold chest armor, no peacock feather, never flower garland (Ep 14 lock / A4 direction)

yudhishthira.face: Eldest Pandava king, calm noble face, modest mustache, dharma in the eyes — distinct from Arjuna
yudhishthira.hair: Dark hair, simple gold diadem (lighter than Arjuna's heavy crown), no peacock feather
yudhishthira.costume: Cream-white royal dhoti and cream angavastram, gold sash, gold armlets, bow of the king — no gold chest armor (Ep 14 canon), no Gandiva, no flower garland

bhima.face: Adult Pandava, broad noble face, full dark mustache, fierce dark eyes — never a child
bhima.hair: Dark hair, gold warrior circlet (not Arjuna's crown, not peacock)
bhima.costume: Deep gold and leaf-green engraved armor, great gold-decked mace — equal human scale, never saffron sage robes

duryodhana.face: Adult Kaurava king, proud upswept mustache, fierce gaze (Ep 13 lock)
duryodhana.hair: Dark hair under a tall jeweled Kuru crown
duryodhana.costume: Jewel-tone gold Kaurava armor with saffron-orange cape, mace — field king, not a sage (distinct from Bhima's circlet and leaf-green armor)

armies.costume: Muted banners, equal human scale, no gore, no bodies
